notes: Karlsplatz is the inner-city hub where U1, U2 and U4 cross; it never appears as a direction. Unlike every other hub in this app, U2 terminates at Karlsplatz rather than passing through it, so only one live U2 direction (towards Seestadt) ever shows there.
